name: @pipeworx/mcp-airnow

tools.name: current_by_zip
tools.description: Latest observed air quality index (AQI) for the EPA AirNow reporting area nearest a US ZIP code: one row per pollutant (ozone, PM2.5, PM10) with the AQI value, category (Good / Moderate / Unhealthy …), observation hour, reporting agency and yesterday's AQI for comparison. Answers "what is the air quality in ZIP 94103 right now".

distance_miles.description: Search radius for the nearest reporting area (default 25, max 250)

tools.name: current_by_location
tools.description: Latest observed air quality index (AQI) for the EPA AirNow reporting area nearest a latitude/longitude in the US: one row per pollutant with AQI value, category, observation hour, agency and yesterday's AQI. Answers "what is the air quality at these coordinates right now".

distance_miles.description: Search radius for the nearest reporting area (default 25, max 250)

tools.name: forecast_by_zip
tools.description: EPA AirNow air quality (AQI) forecast for a US ZIP code — today and up to three days ahead, per pollutant, with the forecast category, Action Day flag and the forecaster's discussion text. Pass a date (YYYY-MM-DD) to get one day, omit it for every day AirNow has issued. Answers "is tomorrow ok for outdoor activity in 60601".

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD forecast day (default: every day AirNow has issued, today + up to 3)

distance_miles.description: Search radius for the nearest reporting area (default 25, max 250)

tools.name: observations_in_bbox
tools.description: Hourly EPA AirNow monitoring-site observations inside a bounding box for a span of UTC hours (max 24 hours per call): per site and hour, the AQI for ozone, PM2.5, PM10 and NO2 and the measured concentrations for PM2.5, ozone, NO2, CO, SO2 and PM10. Specify pollutants as comma-separated codes ("OZONE,PM25,PM10,CO,NO2,SO2"). bbox format: "minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat"; dates as "YYYY-MM-DDTHH" (UTC). Answers "which monitors in the LA basin exceeded AQI 100 yesterday".

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH (UTC hour, inclusive; at most 23 hours after start_date)

data_type.description: A (AQI only) | C (concentration only) | B (both, default)

verbose.description: Include site status, EPA region, elevation, data source agency and reporting areas

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-airnow forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the airnow pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
